weather_report:
Perth is hushed at this hour, a late-night hush with a few shreds of cloud drifting over a dark, inky sky. It feels cool and uncomplicated, the sort of stillness that makes streetlights look like small theatres. Toward dawn the patchwork thins to barely a veil, and the morning opens wide and clean.

Expect a sunny day with a high, blue ceiling and just a whisper of cloud. The light will sharpen quickly after sunrise; by late morning the sun will have some bite and the UV will run high, so plan on shade, sunscreen, and good sunglasses. The day promises clarity more than drama: no hint of rain, colours crisp, horizons tidy. Start with a light layer for the chill, shift to airy fabrics by mid-morning, and keep a hat handy. It’s a fine day for an early walk, a calm ride to work, hanging the washing, a coffee on the verandah, or an unhurried circuit of errands while the streets are still gentle.
